about.en: JPMorgan Chase bStock (JPMB) is a tokenized share of JPMorgan Chase & Co. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xbd49d695ba2cc46c8c603eb62afcd7fff4698281, backed 1:1 by JPM shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
